goal: Validate Student 2 Release 1 MCP and RAG integration: the shared MCP server's read-only accommodation tools, the shared RAG server's grounded and insufficient-context answers for feature student-2, and the Student 2 backend and frontend routes that use both
_note: Local run only; needs host AI-Mode, RAG and MCP plus the Compose stack. Set BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000 FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9003 MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8012 RAG_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8011 CHECKS_FILE=checks/student-2-release-1.json. All checks are read-only. The assistant check depends on the model choosing a tool, so a miss there is worth one retry before it is a failure.

rules: Student 2 MCP tools are read-only: accommodations_search, accommodations_get and accommodations_committed_costs call only the Student 2 public API with GET or QUERY.
The assistant is model-directed: AI-Mode runs the MCP loop and the backend returns its tool trace; the trace, not the reply, is the evidence a tool ran.
RAG confidence is calculated by the RAG server from retrieval scores; an insufficient-context answer has no citations.
The browser sends only a question; the Student 2 backend fixes the RAG feature (student-2) and top_k.
